Callout.Name: Multiple People Unwell
Callout.Message: Several customers unwell at a restaurant.
Callout.Advisory: Four people, all vomiting, same meal.

Script.Line: It is the buffet. Everybody who had the buffet is like this.
Nine of them now. Three went home before we thought to call you.
It is still out on the table. Nobody has touched it since.

Lines.Approach: Four of them, all the same meal, and the kitchen is still serving. Start with the worst.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
